commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+2' Joan Jordan (Sevilla) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' 5 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Miguel Gutierrez slips the ball through to Cristhian Stuani (Girona), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent low shot into the back of the net. He makes it 5:1.
88' The attendance is 13092.

87' Excellent touch by Erik Lamela (Sevilla)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
84' The Sevilla players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
83' The number of shots on goal at present is 7:2.

79' Yan Couto (Girona) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards right side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Marko Dmitrovic pulls off an easy save.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Djibril Sow leaves the pitch and Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) comes on.
77' Here's the change. Lucas Ocampos leaves the pitch and Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) comes on as a substitute.
73' Michel has decided to substitute Artem Dovbyk and he is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Savio departs the field of play to be replaced by Pablo Torre (Girona).
68' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
67' A corner kick by Girona is thwarted by the well prepared Marko Dmitrovic (Sevilla).
66' The substitution is prepared. Valery (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Viktor Tsygankov.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) will replace Yangel Herrera.
66' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.
63' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to Hannibal Mejbri (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
62' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hannibal Mejbri (Sevilla) replacing Suso.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Erik Lamela (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch so that Isaac Romero can be given a rest.
61' What was Djibril Sow (Sevilla) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
59' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

59' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick low shot towards the middle of the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows Paulo Gazzaniga to make a comfortable save.

56' 4 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Savio picks out an unmarked Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball low into the middle of the goal. 4:1.
53' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
53' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
53' Girona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
53' The ball is cleared after Savio (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Girona will take a corner.
49' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows the whistle, Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is penalised for a foul.
46' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Quique Sanchez Flores gives a chance to Marcao and Loic Bade (Sevilla) is off.
46' The whistle blows and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
45+1' Loic Bade (Sevilla) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' The game is interrupted. Daley Blind (Girona) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
44' Sevilla players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
43' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) plays a through ball but overhits it.
42' Yan Couto (Girona) tries to find Viktor Tsygankov, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
41' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) attempts to find Artem Dovbyk with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.
39' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
37' What a chance that is! Portu (Girona) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!
36' Savio (Girona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
35' Yan Couto (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
32' Girona are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
30' Juanpe is being substituted because of an injury. Michel sends Antal Yaakobishvili (Girona) on the pitch.
27' Daley Blind (Girona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
26' Daley Blind (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
23' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.

19' 3 - 1 Goal! Artem Dovbyk (Girona) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Marko Dmitrovic had no chance of reaching it. The score is 3:1.
17' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
15' 2 - 1 Portu provides Artem Dovbyk (Girona) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
13' 1 - 1 Artem Dovbyk (Girona) scores from a seemingly difficult position as he leaps high to head home a cross, putting the ball beyond the reach of the goalkeeper.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Isaac Romero (Sevilla) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.

8' Savio (Girona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
6' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
4' A pass by Jesus Navas (Sevilla) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
2' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
